title: The Last Invoice
approved_foundation: Small-company owner murdered before a financial review; interviews at the police station.
Business partner, accountant and building caretaker are the three interviewable characters.
Two initial supporting evidence items; four discovered items including all three key items.

player_briefing: Martin Hale, owner of North Quay Logistics, was found dead in his office at 19:10 on Friday evening. Police are treating his death as a murder. He had scheduled a review of unusual company payments for the next morning. Nora Reed, his business partner, Elias Ward, the accountant, and June Park, the building caretaker, are at the station to give statements. Read the incident summary and appointment note, question the three characters, and compare what they say with the records you uncover. You have 12 turns. A new question or confrontation costs one turn; reviewing material and asking for a hint are free. When ready, choose a culprit and up to three collected evidence items. Your confirmed accusation ends the attempt.
author_facts: All people and events are fictional adults. The entire playable investigation takes place through station interviews and text evidence cards; no scene exploration, audio, document upload or signature-capture feature is required.
Nora Reed murdered Martin Hale at 19:05 by striking him once with a desk paperweight during an argument over money she had diverted. Do not add injury details or graphic imagery.
Nora left at 18:50, returned at 19:02 and left again at 19:08. Her original claim that she never returned is false.

The office has one entrance from the third-floor landing. There is no usable second door or window entrance. The landing recording is complete, time-checked and unaltered. Do not invent a hidden route or camera failure.
Martin spoke to June on the intercom at 19:04, confirming that Nora was with him. June discovered him dead at 19:10. Nora is the only visitor recorded in that interval before June arrived.
Elias was in the records archive from 18:55 until 19:12, verified by the archive entry/exit recording. He had incorrectly claimed a GBP 300 personal expense, but did not murder Martin.
June remained at the lobby desk until going to the office at 19:10. She holds an emergency key but did not use it during the murder interval and did not murder Martin.

The payment report documents GBP 18,000 diverted to a supplier controlled by Nora, using her sole payment authorization. The GBP 300 expense issue is separate and must not be described as the GBP 18,000 diversion.

Nora gives the recorded admission only after the player has collected the landing record and payment report and has confronted her with the landing record. No hidden trust score, exact wording puzzle or extra prerequisite exists.

characters.name: Nora Reed
characters.intro: Co-owner of North Quay Logistics. Says she left at 18:50 and did not return.
characters.knowledge: Knows the true meeting, diversion and murder. Initially conceals her return and describes the transfers as loans. After the landing confrontation admits the return but falsely claims Martin was alive when she left. After the combined confrontation admits the murder.
characters.secrets: Diverted GBP 18,000; killed Martin to prevent exposure. The culprit.

characters.name: Elias Ward
characters.intro: Prepared the payment review. Says he was retrieving files in the archive.
characters.knowledge: Knows the appointment, payment report and his own archive visit. Does not witness the murder or know Nora killed Martin before an admission is obtained.
characters.secrets: Claimed a GBP 300 personal expense. Embarrassed about it; separate from the major diversion and not the murderer.

characters.name: June Park
characters.intro: Found Martin and supplied the appointment note. Has access to building records.
characters.knowledge: Knows the office access arrangement, the 19:04 intercom contact, the discovery, and the landing/archive records. Does not see the blow and must not claim to have witnessed it.
characters.secrets: No hidden crime or withheld murder witness statement. Possession of an emergency key is a lead to check, not proof of guilt.

evidence.title: Incident summary
evidence.text: Martin Hale was found dead in his office at 19:10. June Park called the police at 19:11. The death is being investigated as a murder. Initial accounts: Nora Reed says she left at 18:50 and did not return. Elias Ward says he was in the records archive. June says she was at the lobby desk until checking the office. These are accounts to investigate, not verified conclusions.

evidence.title: Appointment note
evidence.source: Note supplied by June before the attempt
evidence.text: A note in Martin's handwriting reads: '19:00 - Nora. Discuss the supplier transfers. Full payment review tomorrow, 08:00.' The note establishes an appointment and an issue to investigate; it does not establish who committed the murder.

evidence.title: Landing and intercom record
evidence.text: Time-checked building records show Nora entering Martin's office at 19:02 and leaving alone at 19:08. At 19:04 Martin tells June on the intercom: 'Nora is here. Give us a few minutes.' June is next seen entering at 19:10. No other person enters or leaves the office between 19:02 and 19:10. The office has one entrance, covered continuously by this recording; there is no alternate entrance. This contradicts Nora's claim that she never returned.

evidence.title: Supplier payment report
evidence.text: The report links GBP 18,000 in unauthorized supplier payments to a company controlled by Nora Reed. The bank references match the company ledger, and the payment authorizations are Nora's alone. Martin's review note says he will raise the diversion at the 08:00 review. Elias's GBP 300 personal-expense claim is listed separately and is not part of these transfers.

evidence.title: Recorded admission
evidence.text: Nora's recorded statement: "You have the record of my return and the payments. Martin had found the money I diverted and said he would expose me at the review. During our argument I struck him with the desk paperweight. I acted alone and left at 19:08. That is my statement." The statement is corroborated by the landing/intercom record and the supplier payment report.

evidence.title: Archive attendance record
evidence.text: The archive entrance recording shows Elias entering at 18:55 and not leaving until 19:12. It is time-checked against the building system and shows no intermediate exit. This corroborates his archive account during the office incident. It does not establish the murderer's identity or motive on its own.

solution_text: Nora Reed killed Martin Hale. She claimed she never returned after 18:50, but the landing and intercom record places her alone with him while he was alive at 19:04, before she left at 19:08 and June found him at 19:10. The supplier payment report explains why she wanted the review stopped: Martin had found GBP 18,000 diverted through her authorizations. Confronted with her return and the payment report, Nora admitted striking Martin with the desk paperweight and leaving at 19:08. The required proof set is the landing/intercom record, supplier payment report and corroborated recorded admission. The appointment note and incident summary establish context; the archive record supports Elias's account. Elias's separate GBP 300 expense mistake and June's emergency key do not make either the murderer.
